name: Screen record
oneLiner: a window shows the brand's screen in slow 3D, a crosshair drags a region out with a live size readout while the rest dims, a glass capture bar rises, Record turns the frame solid red with a breathing dot and a running timer, the pointer clicks Stop, the frame flashes and the region shrinks into a floating clip thumbnail with a play button, its duration and a green saved chip
say: when the speaker says they just recorded their screen or shows how they film a demo ('I record a quick walkthrough', 'hit record, show it, done'): the drag lands on 'record', Stop and the saved clip on 'done'
